title: Signal: Requirements file that disables binary wheels globally
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package.
limitations: It matches a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions a `--no-binary` switch that forces source builds for every package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
